t1981:
A girl who suddenly volunteered to be Bell's supporter, working behind the scenes on his Dungeon expeditions.
Ever since Bell saved her from a tight spot in the Dungeon, she's adored him.
t1982:
An adventurer of the Hestia Familia.
She's wearing an adult-size Prum swimsuit, determined to win Bell's heart.
Rumor has it the water gun is for warding off any woman who gets close to him.
t1983:
A human waitress at The Benevolent Mistress, a tavern in Orario.
After a chance meeting with Bell, a fledgling adventurer, she started making him a boxed lunch every morning out of concern.
t1984:
The poster girl waiting tables at The Benevolent Mistress.
Her morning routine is handing Bell a boxed lunch on his way to the Dungeon, though rumor has it the flavor is...rather unique. Or maybe not.
t1985:
A girl who works at The Benevolent Mistress.
She secretly tagged along when Ryu headed to Pumpkeen Village.
For the village festival, she's dressed up as a witch to match Ryu.
t1986:
A human waitress at The Benevolent Mistress, a tavern in Orario.
Invited by the god Hermes on a vacation to the shores of Lake Lolog, she changed into a swimsuit.
Elegant with a hint of devilish allure, it brings out this fine town girl's charm many times over.
t1987:
A human waitress at The Benevolent Mistress, a tavern in Orario.
She met Bell on a street corner in Orario, and after making many memories together, she fell for him.
And at last, at the Goddess Festival, she asks Bell out on a date...
t1988:
An adventurer raised by the god Takemikazuchi since childhood.
She has feelings for Kashima Ouka of the same familia, but between her shyness and Ouka's obliviousness, they show no sign of getting through to him.
t1989:
An archer adventurer of the Takemikazuchi Familia. She hails from the Far East and grew up with Mikoto, Ouka, and Haruhime.
Though an archer, she often works as a supporter.
t1990:
An adventurer of the Takemikazuchi Familia.
Timid in love and wanting to change the self who can never take that step, she put on a dress despite her embarrassment.
Her charm, like dream cherry blossoms glowing in the dusk, combined with the gods' favorite "moe point"—eyes hidden behind her bangs—makes for devastating firepower.
t1991:
An adventurer of the Loki Familia.
When circumstances led her to don a pure white outfit left behind by "the most dangerous familia in history," some curse turned her into a lonely, teary-eyed clingy girl.
To fill her endless loneliness, she desperately chases love, hoping to become someone's bride.
t1992:
An adventurer of the Loki Familia.
She's wearing the battle cloth Harmonia bought her while she was showing Harmonia around town.
Harmonia praised her, saying she looked just like a lady knight from a heroic saga.
t1993:
An adventurer of the Loki Familia.
She's a first-tier adventurer widely known as the "Sword Princess"...but this time, events have led her to pose as Lovely Blue, a "magical girl," and uphold justice.
Though she doesn't seem to quite understand what a "magical girl" is.
t1994:
A first-tier adventurer of the Freya Familia.
The Freya Familia's strategist, feared by the title Hildr Sleif, whose outstanding command ability rivals even that of Finn, the Braver.
He excels at ultra-long-range, ultra-precise magic bombardment, overwhelming and trampling the battlefield in combat as well.
t1995:
One of the deities who descended from the heavens. Lazy by nature.
She looks young and is short, but her ample bust has earned her the name "Loli Goddess."
She loves her familia member Bell to the point of obsession!
t1996:
Patron goddess of the Hestia Familia.
She may be lazy, but the other gods acknowledge her kind divine nature and care for her followers, and she's deeply trusted.
As always, her love for Bell knows no bounds.
t1997:
Patron goddess of the Hestia Familia.
She's in a white-and-blue swimsuit that suits her perfectly.
She splurged on it for a pool date with Bell.
t1998:
Patron goddess of the Hestia Familia.
She and Artemis have been close friends since their days in the heavens.
But when they reunite in the mortal world, she senses something off about how much Artemis has changed.
t1999:
Patron goddess of the Hestia Familia.
She's wearing a calm, elegant dress that leaves a different impression than usual.
For shy Chigusa's sake, she ropes in lots of acquaintances to plot a strategy against the oblivious Ouka.
t2000:
Patron goddess of the Hestia Familia.
She's wearing a bunny girl outfit she bought to surprise Bell at the Holy Night Festival party.
Her healthy yet bewitching bunny look sends even the customers at the Jyaga Maru-kun stand into a frenzy: "Jyaga-jyaga me, pleeease!!"
t2001:
Patron goddess of the Loki Familia, one of the largest in Orario.
Sloppy by nature and usually without a shred of dignity, she has a bold, fearless side that goes all the way when it counts. She and Hestia are like cats and dogs.
t2002:
Patron goddess of the Loki Familia.
Her swimsuit shows off her dazzling, gorgeous legs.
Dreaming of giggly, flirty fun with her swimsuit-clad children, she quietly schemes behind the scenes.
t2003:
Patron goddess of the Freya Familia, a powerful faction that stands as the Loki Familia's equal in Orario.
She's the goddess of beauty, said to be the finest in all the heavens, with looks that stand head and shoulders above even the other gods.
She seems to have taken a liking to Bell and keeps a constant watch on him.
t2004:
Patron goddess of the Freya Familia, a powerful faction that stands as the Loki Familia's equal in Orario.
She wields a terrifying power of Charm that can shatter even divine law.
As a "girl" and as a "goddess," she crossed paths with Bell again and again...and came to love him, the one boy her Charm doesn't work on, from the bottom of her heart.
At the end of those uncontainable feelings, Freya—
t2005:
Patron goddess of the Hephaistos Familia, which trains a great many smiths.
Stubborn but caring, she gives even the lowest-ranked smiths of her familia a workshop of their own.
She's Hestia's one true friend in the mortal world, too.
t2006:
Patron goddess of the Hephaistos Familia, also known as the Divine Master Smith.
She can forge supreme arms even without her Arcanum.
The gear her familia produces is one of Orario's leading brands.
t2007:
Patron god of the Miach Familia, which runs the Blue Pharmacy.
He took on enormous debt to save a follower who lost her arm, reducing his familia to a tiny one.
Still, since his follower Nahza was saved, he doesn't mind.
t2008:
Patron god of the Miach Familia, which runs the Blue Pharmacy.
As fellow tiny familias, he gets along well with Hestia and Takemikazuchi, and they often help each other out.
t2009:
Patron god of the Takemikazuchi Familia, from the Far East.
His tiny familia is poor, so he throws himself into part-time work.
He sometimes competes with his good friend Hestia selling Jyaga Maru-kun.
t2010:
Patron god of the Takemikazuchi Familia, whose members are the children he protected back in the Far East.
As a god of war he's versed in every martial art and combat technique, yet he's gentle and sincere.
He's the very one who taught Hestia the dogeza.
t2011:
Patron god of the Hermes Familia.
Free-spirited and breezy, he roams the world wherever his whims take him.
He often helps Bell out, but his goals are unknown and his actions mysterious.
t2012:
Patron god of the Hermes Familia, which strives to stay neutral.
Affable to everyone and never making enemies, he's a crafty god who seems all the more unfathomable the longer you spend with him.
He keeps an eye on Bell and reaches out to him at key moments.
t2013:
Patron god of the Hermes Familia.
In this latest uproar, at Ouranos's request and Artemis's plea, he became the storyteller of the grand stage that is the hunt for Antares.
He sets out to handle even that great task as breezily as ever. However—
t2014:
An adventurer of the Loki Familia.
Aware of her own inexperience and lack of strength, she keeps working at it bit by bit to catch up to Ais and the other first-tier adventurers, her seniors in the familia.
t2015:
An adventurer of the Loki Familia.
She's wearing a pink swimsuit with adorable frills.
She gets jerked around by the ever-willful Loki and by Ais, who's been sweet-talked by Loki.
t2016:
An adventurer of the Loki Familia.
She's wearing the battle cloth she made together with Riveria.
Curious about Ais's...rendezvous? with Mord, she ends up teaming up with Bell.
t2017:
Captain of the Hermes Familia and a once-in-a-generation Item Maker.
Because she's so capable, her free-spirited patron god keeps pushing impossible demands on her and dragging her around, so her days are full of worry.
t2018:
A Renard who was saved by Bell and made the Conversion to the Hestia Familia.
She hails from the Far East and grew up with Mikoto, Chigusa, and the others. She sees a hero in Bell, who saved her, and harbors a faint crush on him.
t2019:
A monster girl born in the Dungeon not long ago.
For some reason she understands language, and has come to interact with Bell and the others. Through her time with Bell and his friends, she's growing up little by little, too.
t2020:
Patron goddess of the Ishtar Familia, which rules Orario's pleasure quarter.
A goddess of beauty with a voluptuous, bewitching allure.
She's excessively fixated on Freya, said to be beauty incarnate.
t2021:
Patron goddess of the Aphrodite Familia.
She's a fearsome goddess who wields the power of Charm, but the gods often tease her for the disappointing personality that shows through here and there.
Based in Maelstra, the Land of Opera, she deeply loves beautiful art and the children who create it.
